text.text_excerpt: Love this Tutti Frutti! Today they had pumpkin pie! It was delicious!!! They carry lots of delicious flavors, and gobs of toppings. It's nice that they carry lots of healthy noshes for your yogurt, and lots decadent ones too. Berries, nuts, granola, yogurt chips, marshmallows, Sno Caps (Holy Moly - I have no self control around Sno Caps), peanut butter cups, cherries, condensed milk, whipped cream, and so many more!! The service is spot on. Today, the guy who waited on us was awesome. He offered tasting samples and was very helpful. The place is clean, bright and inviting. I'll be back again and again!

I've been hitting up this spot since I started college! I love all of their fruity flavors. It seems like they switch their flavors up every few days. I actually like that they serve the samples for you, to me it gives the place a slightly higher quality feel. The toppings ALWAYS look fresh and fully stocked. Nothing is every sticky and gross. Workers are usually upbeat high school kids. They also give you a punch card so every ninth visit is a free cup of froyo! I don't frequent this place super often but every time I come I'm completely satisfied!

I never been a yogurt person, but I decided I deserved a treat and this was the location for it. There were several flavors to try but both times visiting I went with Wedding Cake and Birthday Cake. What I love the most is the fact that I can pick all of my own toppings. So I went a little overboard. You have to be careful because your yogurt must be weighed! Keep that in mind before you end up with one yogure for 15 bucks. It's in an area with ample parking so no need to worry about that. There is no seating but you are close to the Lakefront if you want to enjoy your tasty treat in peace.
